name: Estorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Estorf (a saw, a mill wheel and a pot on green and white).
history: The arms were resolved by the municipal council on 21 September 1973 and approved by the Landkreis Stade on 17 December 1973.

features.role: Estorf arms — saw, wheel and pot
